question:
Anu, Dilip, Eshwar, Jahanvi, Komal, Pallavi, Riya, and Tara are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table (but not necessarily in the same order). Some of them are sitting at the corners, while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides. Tara is to the immediate right of Komal and to the immediate left of Jahanvi. Anu is to the immediate left of Riya. Dilip and Jahanvi have only one person between them. Eshwar is sitting at the exact centre of one of the sides and has Riya to the immediate left and Komal to the immediate right.

Who is sitting to the immediate right of Pallavi?
solution:
**Given:**

Anu, Dilip, Eshwar, Jahanvi, Komal, Pallavi, Riya, and Tara are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table.

Some of them are sitting at the corners, while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides.

According to the given information,

(1.) Tara is to the immediate right of Komal and to the immediate left of Jahanvi.
